# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b2 — Compact settings beta

**Optional GitHub/HACS prerelease · Home Assistant 2026.10+**

This is a beta for users who opt into testing. The last stable release remains
[v0.5.1](https://github.com/Chreece/HA-Air-Quality-Advisor/releases/tag/v0.5.1),
and the earlier v0.6.0b1 beta remains available. Neither the original
`air_quality_advisor` domain nor user entity IDs, historical config entries,
Announcement Hub routing or installed HACS repository are renamed.

## New in beta 2

- **Simpler Settings navigation:** Outside data (weather, warnings, air-quality
  sensors, AQI scales and pollen); General settings (global presence, occupied
  rooms and sleep sources); Area settings (window exclusions, per-room
  environment/climate settings and equipment).
- **Fixed international pollen configuration:** independent page for a real
  pollen provider, its index scale, high threshold and ventilation warning.
  AQI provider selection is now separated into an explicitly validated page.
- **Room/home occupancy and sleep:** choose HA room presence sensors, people or
  trackers, and optionally one entity whose state or named attribute contains
  a JSON/list of actual HA room IDs or display names, such as
  `["living_room", "bedroom"]`. Unknown, stale and ambiguous readings hold
  commands; they never imply an empty room or household.
- **Device-by-device setup:** select an area and all discovered native
  `climate.*`, `fan.*` and `humidifier.*` entities are preselected for
  **monitoring only**. Each device has a separate automatic-control consent,
  applicable setpoint or speed targets, room/home occupancy requirement,
  safe absence action, sleep behavior, and hardware protections.
- **Independent command safety:** current occupancy and sleeping state are
  checked again immediately before new commands. A room with newly detected
  presence cannot still be powered down from a stale plan. Sleep pause has
  priority over absence OFF; uncertain safety histories require reconciliation.
  Explicit native HEAT/COOL absence OFF leaves the thermostat OFF and never
  autonomously restarts it.
- **All 38 languages** regenerated with the compact menus and per-device
  labels; full revised descriptions for the Greek interface, alongside
  German and English.
- Additional edge-case tests for device discovery, unsupported DRY-only
  temperature setpoints, stale sources and conflicting controllers.

## Upgrade through HACS

1. Back up Home Assistant, including its `.storage` data.
2. Open [Home Environment Manager in HACS](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/hacs_repository/?owner=Chreece&repository=HA-Air-Quality-Advisor&category=integration).
3. Select **Redownload** or **Version selection**, enable **Show beta versions**
   if necessary, and choose **v0.6.0b2**. Restart Home Assistant.
4. Review your existing room settings and new shared occupancy source.
   All new auto-control functions require **separate explicit permission**.
5. Use `home_environment_manager.climate_diagnostics` in Developer Tools →
   Actions to inspect actual configured device capabilities without commands.

If your HACS version cannot select this prerelease, use the attached
`HA-Air-Quality-Advisor-v0.6.0b2.zip` as a **manual installation asset**,
extracting `custom_components/air_quality_advisor` into your HA config and
restarting. HACS itself uses the tagged repository source, not this ZIP.

## Safety and known limits

**No independent physical compressor, electrical, fan or humidifier
commissioning is claimed.** Physical AC DRY/FAN_ONLY switching, direct thermal
relays and dedicated fan/humidifier power controls remain experimental,
disabled by default and require real manufacturer/device protection tests.
Absence-triggered OFF requires an explicitly supported native mode and the
specific device's hardware confirmation; it is never an automatic turn-ON
system. Unknown occupancy, stale sensors, unsupported modes, conflicting
owners and manual override states remain holds.

The sensor engine remains deterministic; Announcement Hub decides delivery
after an actual selected-area notification is handed off. The integration
never opens windows automatically.
